title: One-page pitch memo
intro: A single page of plain writing that explains your company to someone who has never heard of it. Share it with possible co-founders, advisers, partners or, if you decide to raise money, investors.

fields.label: Company or project name
fields.help: A working name is fine, such as "Pharmacy expiry tracker", and you can change it later.

fields.label: One-line description
fields.help: Say who it's for and what changes for them in words a stranger would understand, such as "We help small pharmacies stop throwing away expired medicine."
fields.placeholder: e.g. We help small pharmacies stop throwing away expired medicine.

fields.label: The problem
fields.help: Describe what happens today, how often, what it costs and how people cope now, for example "staff spend a day a month checking expiry dates by hand, and stock still expires".

fields.label: The customer
fields.help: Describe them precisely enough that a reader could find one this week, and say who pays if that's someone else, for example "owners of independent pharmacies with one to three branches; assistants use it, owners pay".

fields.label: Your solution
fields.help: Explain what the customer does with your product and the result they get before mentioning any technology, for example "staff scan each shelf with a phone once a week and get a list of what to sell first".

fields.label: Why now
fields.help: Name the specific recent change in technology, cost, rules or behavior that makes this possible or necessary now, for example "medicine packs now carry a scannable code that includes the expiry date".

fields.label: Traction or evidence so far
fields.help: List only what's true today, with numbers, such as "18 interviews with pharmacy owners" or "3 pharmacies on a paid pilot", and if it's early, say so and add what you're testing next.

fields.label: Market and business model
fields.help: Say how you'll charge, then estimate the market from the bottom up, for example "50 euros a month, and about 4,000 independent pharmacies in our country, so a ceiling of roughly 2.4 million euros a year".

fields.label: Team
fields.help: Say who is involved and why you're suited to this problem, for example "a former pharmacy assistant who saw the problem every week and a developer who has built stock software".

fields.label: What you're asking for, and your next milestone
fields.help: Make one concrete request tied to a milestone, for example "introductions to five pharmacy owners for a paid pilot we want running by September".
